brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 to Penrose Park 230/34kV ahead of the forecast heat event, because an ageing unit with an oil issue has a reduced margin against mechanical failure and requires pre-event attention. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period as required by MG-021.
